title: refactor(app-shell): `/` keeps one resolver — remove the unguarded published twin
body:
Fixes #10042

**Direction chosen: remove the unguarded published twin.** In one line, as the ruling asks — it is the smaller diff (9 files, +170/-82, of which +102 is a new pin test, against the 812 lines of resolver and `/` tests the other direction would have had to move and re-mock), and it is the only one of the two that leaves the ruling's acceptance green.

Clause-②: no — re-declared from this diff, not inherited. It removes one export (`RootRedirect`) and adds none: no new export, no new accepted input, no option, no prop, no extension point. The published `/` behaviour does change; that is the ruling, and it is spelled out for a consumer in `.changeset/10042-one-root-resolver.md`.

## The measurement that decided the direction

The ruling named its own confidence gap — can `resolveLandingPath`'s dependencies live inside `app-shell`? It has two halves, and they answer differently.

**Half 1 — the dependencies themselves: yes, every one of them.** The console's `/` element imports six symbols beyond React, and all six are already reachable inside `app-shell`. Enumerated with a control in the same command: an invented seventh name reports absent, so the reader is known to discriminate.

| symbol | where it already lives |
| --- | --- |
| `useMetadata` | `app-shell`'s `providers/MetadataProvider`, which re-exports it from `@object-ui/react` |
| `LoadingFallback`, `SETUP_APP_PACKAGE_ID`, `SETUP_APP_NAME` | `app-shell`'s `console/ConsoleShell.tsx` |
| `RedirectWithSplash` | `app-shell`'s `chrome/RedirectWithSplash.tsx` |
| `MetadataTypeStatus` | `app-shell`'s `providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` |

Nothing it needs is console-local. So the logic *can* be hosted in the package.

**Half 2 — hosting it there costs the acceptance. Measured, not assumed.** I built that move as a throwaway probe — the element copied into `app-shell` with relative imports, exported from the barrel, the console file reduced to a re-export — and ran the acceptance against it. `RootLandingRedirect.route.test.tsx` came back **7 failed / 54 passed**, first failure `AssertionError: expected '/home' to be '/apps/crm_app'`. The mechanism is the one `homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256.test.ts` already records in its own words: those routing tests mock `@object-ui/app-shell` wholesale, so an element living *inside* the package reads the real hooks that the mock never reaches. The pure-policy test and both parity tests stayed green in the same run — a same-subject control showing the failure is specific to that mocked boundary, not to the move in general.

The probe's mutation and its restore were each proved by content, never by an exit code: the shim's blob changed to `b4fcc24f` while the probe ran, and afterwards the file is `2ed110ae` again, equal to its `HEAD` blob, with `git status --porcelain` empty and the probe module gone from disk.

⇒ A resolver hosted in `app-shell` is a resolver the console's `/` tests can no longer reach — and those tests are the acceptance. The direction that keeps them is the one that removes the twin, which is also the smaller diff.

## Before / after — the acceptance, green and unchanged

Every run below printed the acceptance files' object hashes next to their `HEAD` blobs in the *same* command as the run.

| run | test files | tests |
| --- | --- | --- |
| before, on a clean tree at `7cbefa540` | 5 passed | 76 passed |
| after, this commit | 8 passed | 104 passed |
| after, the whole `apps/console` project | 103 passed | 1173 passed |

`apps/console` contributes no file to this diff at all — `git status --porcelain -- apps/console` printed nothing, in the same command as that 1173-test run. `homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256.test.ts` is byte-identical at `074545a2`, equal to its `HEAD` blob, before and after.

The new pin `rootLandingHasOneResolver-10042.test.ts` carries the RED-before / GREEN-after: 2 failed / 2 passed on the unmodified tree (its CONTROL case green, so the reader was known to work while the two absence cases were red), 4 passed after the removal.

## What changed

- `RootRedirect` and its barrel export are gone from `@object-ui/app-shell`. It was mounted by nothing in this repo except the starter example; `apps/console` never mounted it (control: the same search finds `RootLandingRedirect` in 12 files).
- `examples/console-starter` now routes `/` in its own route table, inside the `AuthenticatedRoute` guard it already had for objectui#4042. It was the only in-repo consumer of the removed export.
- The objectui#7373 launcher scan loses the cut-out region it held open for the removed body, so it now reads `ConsoleShell.tsx` whole — stricter, not quieter, exactly as that file's own comment predicted.
- `bootRedirectCoverage` loses the case for the element that no longer exists.

## Verification

- `@object-ui/app-shell` dependency closure build: green, 928 emitted files verified by `check-dist-completeness`.
- Type-check, all three, after building the prerequisites they resolve through: `@object-ui/app-shell` Done, `@object-ui/console` Done, `@object-ui/example-console-starter` Done. The console's first type-check run failed only on five sibling plugin packages whose dist was absent in this worktree; recorded as a prerequisite gap, the packages were built, and the re-run is the verdict quoted here.
- Gates run on the committed tree: `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset declared for 5 changed source files), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:comment-mask-corpus` — all exit 0. `check:readme-exports` first reported 8 unjudgeable self-imports against unbuilt `cli` / `plugin-ai` dists; that is a prerequisite gap rather than a verdict, so those were built and it was re-run over a whole population (`0 unbuilt`).
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over this diff's nine paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint over the nine changed paths: 0 errors (8 pre-existing warnings in `ConsoleShell.tsx`, none of them from this diff).
- Not measured locally: the `packages/app-shell` package suite in full and the repo-wide `pnpm lint` — both left to CI. The removed symbol's importers were enumerated exhaustively from the ref with a positive control, and both were edited here.

## Acceptance notes

- `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` still names `RootRedirect` in its route diagram and in its list of published building blocks, so this change leaves that guide stale. Deliberately not touched: it is a governed surface, and a single file from there forks this whole PR onto the governed landing path — AGENTS.md's own instruction for that case is to split governed files into their own pull request. Reported to the PM rather than folded in.
- The pending changesets for objectui#6507 and objectui#7373 narrate `RootRedirect` as a thing that exists. Left alone — they are another card's unreleased narrative, and `check:changeset-claims` is report-only and exits 0 here.
- `ROADMAP.md` carries a historical checkbox naming it. Historical record, left alone.
